# vendors/cas_to_hspip

Open glue scripts copied from `cas-to-HSPiP_data` (MIT).

**Not included:** HSPiP.exe, CLI license files, or `.sofx` solvent databases.

Set `HSPIP_PATH` before using `HSPiP_CLI_v7.py`. Prefer DoSS sofx lookup via
`HSPIP_DATA` / `HSPIP_DATA_DIR` for interactive D/P/H fills.

See `docs/HSPiP_CLI.md` and the README in this folder.
